prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished, high-fidelity desktop web app screenshot for ClearLedger, a PERSONAL expense and monthly budget tracker, at a landscape 1536x1024 composition. Render the entire app viewport edge to edge with crisp readable UI, no device frame, no photography, no perspective. Fixed approved visual world: bright calm ledger; deep olive navigation #233326, pale cool white canvas #F5F6F2, white panels, dark green-black typography, lime #BFE47B primary actions, warm muted terracotta/ochre/sage categorical charts. Modern humanist sans-serif typography like DM Sans, thin neutral dividers, meticulous alignment, generous breathing room, exact tabular money numerals, precise small stroked icons. Beautiful actual usable finance software, not a marketing page. Navigation: ClearLedger brand with a simple leaf-like geometric mark; Overview, Transactions, Budgets; bottom settings and 'Saved on this device'. Main heading 'Your month, at a glance' and supporting copy 'A little clarity for your everyday spending.' Top right month selector 'November 2026', and primary button '+ Add transaction'. Include small truthful 'Sample data' badge and 'Start fresh' action. All illustrative numbers consistent: income $4,850.00; expenses $2,340.50; remaining $2,509.50. Categories: Housing $1,200; Food & dining $480.50; Shopping $280; Transport $180; Entertainment $120; Other $80; sum $2,340.50. Transaction rows show Rent, Grocery run, Coffee & lunch, Train pass, Freelance project with date, category, amount. Budget examples: Food & dining $480.50 / $600; Shopping $280 / $250 over budget; Transport $180 / $250. Charts carry meaningful axes and value labels. Include clear labeled actions 'View all transactions' and 'Edit budgets'. No invented account avatars, bank cards, savings goals, credit scores, billing, or banking integration. No ornamental illustrations, gradients, glassmorphism, irrelevant widgets, or huge hero art. Maintain professional readable text at a minimum 14px appearance.
Composition A — Balanced overview: full-height olive sidebar 224px wide. Main area top title, then a single broad white horizontal summary strip with three financial figures separated by subtle vertical rules. Beneath, large spending breakdown panel on the left with an elegant donut chart, centered total and category legend, and a narrower monthly budget panel on the right with three readable category budget bars. Lower section a full-width recent transactions table with a restrained column header and four visible rows. Left sidebar includes a bottom pale-olive reassurance panel reading 'Small steps. Better habits.' Make the composition feel thoughtful, spacious and serene.
